title: 科加斯·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 红紫甲壳构成非人类外形，头部尖角、分立肢体与长尾轮廓清楚。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Cho'Gath is a colossal red-purple Void monster with a broad armored carapace, prominent head horns, several distinct limb silhouettes, and a long heavy tail. Preserve the recognizable insectoid-dinosaur anatomy and substantial nonhuman mass rather than humanizing the creature. Keep the mouth closed, the eyes composed, and chitin surfaces clean, with no gore, exposed innards, frightening teeth, or threatening lunge.
art_direction.scene: A composed near-profile study with a gentle head turn, signature forms stacked into a tall diagonal, luminous rim and airy negative space. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: plum, oxblood red, copper rim, cool stone; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
